lean.statement:
{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] (g : E → E) (eta eps : ℝ) (y : E)
    {n m : ℕ} {x : E} {r s : E × ℕ}
    (hr : run g eta eps y n x = some r)
    (hs : run g eta eps y m x = some s) : r = s
approved_definition_context: The finite interpreter run(g,eta,eps,y,fuel,x) returns none at zero fuel. With positive fuel it evaluates g(x), sets next=y-eta*g(x), returns some(x,1) if ||next-x||<=(1-eta)*eps, otherwise recurses from next with one less fuel and adds one to a successful returned query count. Arithmetic is exact real arithmetic. Returned pairs contain the output point and the actual number of gradient evaluations, including the final successful test.
